acceptance_cases.required_behavior: No archived-title liveness, duplicate writer, replacement #7175 or unresolved effect replay.
Capture exact failed tests and actual built inputs; do not conflate workflow SHA, checkout SHA and generated output.
Fatal publication refuses unavailable proof; warning+exit0 cannot certify a generation.
Use supported serial proof rather than a pass or a false semantic failure.
Refuse even with zero pytest status; bind proof to immutable pre/post input/output digests.
Valid unchanged-input pass permits; failing suite refuses; no weakened schema or disabled fatal gate.
Proof covers the exact rebuilt generation or exact unchanged identity, not the earlier tree.
Preserve bounded failed names/assertions and full proof refs through existing evidence owner; never infer cause from count.
Skipped build/proof/publication is not a new published-generation proof.
FMS source generation and served candidate lineage separately observed; acquisition alone does not certify consumer.
Differentiate event age, observation, generation and serving times; historical serialized ok is not current ok.
Use evidenced public/house availability; recent absent row is not no-award and a90-day-late row is not contemporaneous event knowledge.
Ceiling/obligation/outlay do not add as independent value; signed de-obligations remain negative.
Proposed sale maximum is not signed case, award, contractor cash or recognized revenue.
Proposal/authorization/appropriation/obligation distinguish version and effective date.
Use reviewed point-in-time legal entity/ownership/role; ticker/name similarity cannot confer economic ownership.
An evidenced supplier link is not a known workshare; prime/supplier value cannot double-count end demand.
Same source/version counts once; correction preserves old view and supplies invalidation lineage.
Revenue/backlog/guidance/working-capital sources retain period/unit/accounting basis; no government residual relabeled reported backlog.
Support negative margin/EAC/capex/cash cases even with increasing orders; show alternative explanations.
Announced target, installed capacity and demonstrated throughput separate; no operational vulnerability/readiness inference.
Participation, demand, economics and recognition stay distinct; no invented conviction score or buying authority.
Algebraic valuation hurdle and observed price response are not observed market expectations or causal effects.
Preregister sample/exclusions, trial budget and clustering; unseen documents/issuers/programs remain held out.
Top-dollar sample/press release corpus is not complete award universe; denominator and censoring explicit.
Issuer/program/day clusters and repeated multi-source events do not inflate N.
Separate stage/economic/equity targets; do not multiply uncalibrated or dependent marginals.
Count once, preserve source/model/cutoff and never backfill historical reconstructions as prospective predictions.
No outcome before horizon; unobserved is not failed; trading calendars and adverse delisting/source gaps explicit.
Baseline/proper-score/uncertainty reproduction; no-go remains visible, no cherry-picked model promotion.
Complete existing collector/contract/consumer on lawful access; prototype award is not production order.
Current public edition/source span/issuer-program linkage; no unsupported legal verdict or classified content.
Each theme has funding stage, exposure, economics, market context, contrary case, next event and sources; no aggregate acceptance hides an empty theme.
No bespoke ticker answers; source-native international/dual listing and JV/ownership cases explicitly qualified.
Source→generation→API→browser evidence on actual installed release; fixture screenshots insufficient.
1440/820/390, EN/ZH, keyboard, source deep links, direct URL/back/focus restoration; no clipped dense default view.
Deny before private data access; no user notes/source bodies in public caches, URLs or logs.
Restore original subject/window/filter/cutoff; new event vs correction/no-change/outage distinguish; existing scheduler only.
Bound requests, retain units/clocks/source refs, safe spreadsheet encoding; no document prompt-injection tool execution.
Actual program-dossier browser proof established separately from D6 source acceptance.
Unknown writes keep original carrier; exact last-good generation restored; no unbounded retries or new publisher.
Measure agreed corpus/network/concurrency distributions and total capture/review/compute cost; no request-time source/model fan-out.
Native Opus coordinates real admitted Fabric operators; shared grant/depth/review budget; no imaginary START or unconsumed children.
No FIF/SNI/risk/OS/Options/Prophet/Ontology/GMI/Fabric build; originalD19 explicitly excluded not completed.
All included waves and mandatory evidence mapped; pending natural outcomes/human gates/effects cannot disappear at a checkpoint.
